text.ja: SRMHD円偏波：有限振幅厳密族と独立テンソル積分 K=rho*h+B0^2*(1+eta^2); vA^2=2*B0^2/(K+sqrt(K^2-4*eta^2*B0^4)); (By,Bz)=eta*B0*(cos(2*pi*(x-vA*t)),sin(2*pi*(x-vA*t))); (vy,vz)=-vA*(By,Bz)/B0. 平坦時空、c=4π=1、γ=4/3、ρ=p=Bx=η=1、vx=0の厳密族。原著2π周期を単位区間へ写し、64/128/256セル、周期境界、t=1/vA。Bxは1次元で固定します。非線形Alfvén速度の閉じた式を使い、点の原始変数から独立なストレステンソルで保存量と流束を作り、Gauss積分と複素段階PDE残差で確認します。原著の2π周期を単位区間へ移しています。
text.en: SRMHD circular wave: finite-amplitude exact family and independent tensor integration K=rho*h+B0^2*(1+eta^2); vA^2=2*B0^2/(K+sqrt(K^2-4*eta^2*B0^4)); (By,Bz)=eta*B0*(cos(2*pi*(x-vA*t)),sin(2*pi*(x-vA*t))); (vy,vz)=-vA*(By,Bz)/B0. Flat spacetime,c=4pi=1,gamma4/3,rho=p=Bx=eta1, exact-family vx0. Rescale the original2pi period to a unit domain;64/128/256 cells,periodic,t=1/vA. Normal Bx is fixed in1D. Use the closed nonlinear Alfven-speed formula. Independently form conserved quantities/fluxes from point primitives through the stress tensor; qualify Gauss integration and complex-step PDE residuals. Rescale the original2pi period to the unit interval.
